title: 第20章 商队第21章 献祭
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
在半路，石泉水遇到一队商队在路边休息，人数只有三十多人，车却有超过四十辆，每辆车上或多或少都沾着血，不用想就知道肯定遇到了袭击。
他看到有个老人靠在车轮上，似乎很清闲，便上前询问一番。
“我们遇到袭击时，倒是看到有有些人去平城方向。至于是不是有你认识的，我不清楚。老弟，我们也回平城，要不要一起？”
老人拍了拍身边的地，示意他坐下来休息。
石泉水想想跟随车队也方便一些，便坐在他旁边。
短短时间发生这么多事情，他真的感觉累了，很怀念以前简简单单生活。
“那就打扰了。”
“你喊我老贾就可以。”
老贾说着把腰间的水壶取下来递给他，又让人取来一些吃的。
“我看你也饿了，吃吧，等会儿还得赶路。”
石泉水也没客气，便大快朵颐起来。
“掌柜的听到城里遇到袭击，赶紧带我们绕了远路，没想还是碰上了，损失了四十个护卫，还有七十多个家丁。出来时大家还商量着回去好好吃一顿，没想到......哎。”
老贾长叹了一声，眉宇间多了几分愧疚。
“袭击你们的是怪物还是黑衣人？”
石泉忽然没了胃口，将吃剩的放在一旁，拿起水壶喝了一大口。
“不知道，但应该是人。怎么，城里遇到了怪物？”
老贾听到怪物忽然有了兴致，冰冷的脸上渐渐有了一丝丝的笑容。
“你知道怪物？”
石泉又喝了一口水，便把水壶还给他。
“当然知道。”

老贾应了一声不紧不慢地从怀里拿出了一个荷包摩挲了起来，眼里的戾气一闪而过。
“你赶紧休息，一刻钟后我们就要出发了，最好能在天黑前赶到，否则得露宿野外了。”
石泉水看得出他心事重重，也不便多问，靠着车子想眯一会。
一个光着脚的清瘦孩子拿着一只串在竹竿上的烤鸡兴奋的跑了过来，穿着的衣服布满了补丁，但很干净。
“阿大，烤鸡烤好了。”
老贾抬头，一边快速地将荷包塞入怀里，一边撑着车轮用力站起身。
“大喜，我跟你说过很多次了，修炼就是要认真修炼，还这么贪玩。”
“阿大，我看着要出发了，就去捉了只野鸡。”
大喜说的同时兴奋地腾出左手摸向怀里。
“我还捡到了雷石呢。”
雷石？
石泉水听到这两个字，立马没了睡意，腾的一下站起来。
那雷石有拳头大小，明显炼化过的，上面还有个像水字的篆字，被涂抹成了红色。
老贾拿着雷石看了片刻，便转身递给石泉水，带着些许不好意思问道：
“您帮忙看看，这雷石怎么样？如果贵的话，拿去卖了，给大喜买点丹药。”
“这是炼化过的雷石，被人用过，也就值四五两银子。”
这雷石很奇怪，明明灵力还算充足，不太可能被抛弃。
content_en:
On the way, Shi Quanshui encountered a group of caravans resting on the roadside. There were only more than thirty people in the caravan, but there were more than forty cars. Each car was more or less stained with blood. It didn't take much to think that they must have been attacked.
He saw an old man leaning on the wheel, seemingly at ease, so he stepped forward to ask.
"When we encountered the attack, we saw some people heading towards Pingcheng. As for whether there are any you know, I don't know. Brother, we are also going back to Pingcheng, do you want to come together?"
The old man patted the ground beside him and motioned for him to sit down and rest.
Shi Quanshui thought it would be more convenient to follow the convoy, so he sat next to him.
So many things happened in a short period of time, he really felt tired and missed the simple life before.
"Then excuse me."
"You can just call me Lao Jia."
As he spoke, Lao Jia took off the kettle from his waist and handed it to him, and asked someone to get some food.
"I see you're hungry too, go ahead and eat, you have to go on your way later."
Shiquan Shui was not polite and started to enjoy the meal.
"When the shopkeeper heard that there was an attack in the city, he quickly took us on a long detour. Unexpectedly, we encountered him and lost forty guards and more than seventy servants. When we came out, we all discussed going back to have a good meal, but we didn't expect... ugh."
Old Jia let out a long sigh, feeling a little guilty on his brows.
"Is the one who attacked you a monster or a man in black?"
Shi Quan suddenly lost his appetite, put the leftover food aside, picked up the kettle and took a big sip.
"I don't know, but it should be a human being. Why, a monster was encountered in the city?"
When Lao Jia heard that the monster suddenly became interested, a smile gradually appeared on his cold face.
"You know monsters?"
Shi Quan took another sip of water and returned the kettle to him.
"Of course I do."
Lao Jia responded and leisurely took out a purse from his arms and started to rub it, with a flash of anger in his eyes.
"You should rest quickly. We will set off in a quarter of an hour. It is best to arrive before dark, otherwise we will have to sleep in the wild."
Shi Quanshui could tell that he was worried, so he couldn't ask more questions and leaned against the car to take a nap.
A skinny, barefooted child ran over excitedly holding a roast chicken skewered on a bamboo pole. His clothes were patched but very clean.
"Ada, the roast chicken is ready."
Lao Jia raised his head, quickly stuffed his purse into his arms, and stood up with strength on the wheel.
"Daxi, I've told you many times that cultivation means practicing seriously, yet you are so playful."
"Ada, I looked like I was about to set off, so I went to catch a pheasant."
Daxi said while excitedly reaching for his arms with his left hand.
"I also picked up the Thunder Stone."
Thunder stone?
When Shi Quanshui heard these two words, he immediately lost his sleepiness and stood up in a hurry.
The thunder stone was about the size of a fist, and it was obviously refined. There was a seal character like water on it, which was painted red.
Lao Jia looked at the thunder stone for a moment, then turned around and handed it to the stone spring water, and asked with a little embarrassment:
"Please help me take a look. How about this thunder stone? If it's expensive, sell it and buy some elixirs for Daxi."
"This is a refined thunder stone. It has been used by others, so it is only worth four or five taels of silver."
This thunder stone is very strange. It clearly has sufficient spiritual power and is unlikely to be abandoned.
